errors.entitlementRequired: The MCP Connector is not licensed on this instance. The board enters a licence on the instance's licence screen.
errors.hostUnsupported: This instance is older than the MCP Connector. Update the instance to use it.
errors.notJsonRpc: The body is not a JSON-RPC message.
errors.connectedAppsOnly: This route serves connected apps only.
errors.insufficientScope: The connected app's access does not cover this.

view.title: MCP Connector
view.intro: An MCP client, such as a chat assistant, acts as the member who connects it, through the actions this instance offers connected apps.

licence.heading: Licence
licence.error: The licence could not be read.
licence.hostUnsupported: This instance is older than the connector, which serves no connected app on it. Update the instance to use the connector.

status.absent: No licence for the connector has been entered.
status.version-not-covered: This release of the connector came out after the last date the licence covers releases to. An earlier release stays covered.
status.wrong-instance: The licence was issued to another instance.
status.tampered: The licence no longer verifies. Enter it again, or ask the issuer for a new one.
status.not-yet-valid: The licence is dated after today, so the clock is wrong on this instance or at the issuer.

licence.endsToday: The licence ends today. Renew it to keep connected apps served.
licence.endsIn_one: The licence ends in {{count}} day. Renew it to keep connected apps served.
licence.endsIn_other: The licence ends in {{count}} days. Renew it to keep connected apps served.
licence.dormant: Without an active licence the connector is dormant: a connected app is told that a licence is required, and is offered no tools. Nothing is switched off, and the connector serves again as before once a licence is active.
licence.enter: The board enters a licence file on the instance's licence screen.

address.heading: Address for MCP clients
address.hint: Give this address to the MCP client. The member signs in to this instance when the client connects, and the client then acts as them.
address.error: The address could not be read.
address.otherHolder: Another plugin holds this instance's address for MCP clients, so a client reaches that plugin and not the connector.

actions.heading: What connected apps may do
actions.body: A connected app is offered the actions this instance offers connected apps, as the member who connected it and never beyond what that member may do. A plugin's actions are offered only once the administrator arms them, on the plugin's own screen.
